MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN ARCS (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 3 RD DAY OF APRIL 2020 
 
 Present 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Chief Executive / Director 
 Imran Ali Khan Director 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 EXTENSION OF LOAN AVAILED FROM ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRVIATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to extend the amount of loan availed by the Company from Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Lender ”) under the loan agreement dated 4 April 2019 , executed by and between the Company and the Lender (“ Loan Agreement ”), from Rs . 300,000,000 (Rupees three hundred million) to Rs . 400,000,000 (Rupees four hundred million). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Zeeshan Ali Khan, Chief Executive of the Company, t o discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved, that the Company extend the amount of loan availed from the Lender under the Loan Agreement from Rs . 300,000,000 (Rupees three hundred million) to Rs . 400,000,000 (Rupees four hundred million) . 
 
 Resolved further, that Zeeshan Ali Khan be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.
